verdict.rationale: No dedicated migration or import tool is documented. The only route is a custom build on the public API, which can create journal entries (account_uuid plus debit/credit) and exposes endpoints for clients, invoices, payments, expenses and bills. That makes migration technically possible but only with substantial engineering work, and fidelity of the transferred detail is unproven. Missing for 10: a first-party import or migration tool from other accounting systems, CSV or file import of historical transactions, documented preservation of transaction-level detail (line items, attachments, payment links), migration assistance services, and independent or hands-on reports of successful migrations.
